scope: All nine MP4 videos in the source image archive.
method: 307 chronological frame samples across the full 73.91 seconds, approximately 0.25 seconds apart, including the first and last decoded frame of every clip; eight additional full-size frame checks. All 2216 source video frames and all audio streams decoded without errors. Visual assessment used frame sequences, not real-time playback; audio quality was not assessed.
quality_scale: Subjective visual quality from 1 to 10, higher is better; considers composition, light, color, clarity, visible motion blur and framing changes across samples. Scores assess footage, never the people pictured.
preservation: Only filenames changed. Original video, audio, embedded metadata, dimensions, duration and frame rate are preserved byte-for-byte.

videos.reason: The close equipment interaction is legible in good daylight, but soft detail, drifting framing and a large camera shadow reduce the finish.
videos.sequence: A man handles a connection at one woman's waist while another watches, then bends down to place the control bar on the sand; the camera shifts toward the second woman as the others leave the edges.
videos.limitations: Low 394-by-848 resolution, visible compression softness, overlapping people at the start, partial edge crops during the pan and a prominent camera operator shadow at the end. Dense chronological frame review, not real-time playback; audio not assessed.

videos.reason: The walking sequence remains understandable, but dark faces, soft distant figures and loose framing weaken visual clarity.
videos.sequence: Two men stand and gesture near kite lines, then walk toward the camera beside each other; the taller man moves partly out of the right edge near the end.
videos.limitations: Low 394-by-848 resolution, coarse compressed detail, backlit figures, large empty foreground, handheld framing drift and a cropped subject at the end. Dense chronological frame review, not real-time playback; audio not assessed.

videos.reason: The full-body action and blue-green bay are clear, though low-resolution softness and shadowed clothing limit equipment detail.
videos.sequence: A helmeted woman lowers the control bar onto the sand, then steps forward while separating and handling lines in front of her harness; the camera follows slightly to the right.
videos.limitations: Low 394-by-848 resolution, compression softness, dark face and torso, mild frame drift and an airborne kite cut by the upper edge. Dense chronological frame review, not real-time playback; audio not assessed.

videos.reason: Bright sea colors and a clearly visible equipment interaction make this usable, but low resolution, shadowed faces and drifting handheld framing limit polish.
videos.sequence: Beside a white kite on the sand, a man and woman handle a red-and-blue control bar and its lines; the view moves closer, then widens as the woman holds the bar and the man steps back.
videos.limitations: 394-by-848 resolution limits fine facial and line detail; hard sunlight darkens faces, the white kite fills much of the lower-left frame, and the camera moves forward and backward with slight tilt. Dense chronological frame review covered 47 samples from 0.000 to 11.321 seconds, including the first and last decoded frames, plus an individual full-size frame; real-time playback and audio were not assessed.

videos.reason: The clip clearly follows several gear demonstrations, but pale contrast, soft detail and long stretches of empty sand reduce its visual impact.
videos.sequence: Starts beside people handling a control bar, moves closer to another group practicing with a bar, then pans toward people raising a yellow kite at the shoreline.
videos.limitations: Low-resolution 394 x 848 source; hazy contrast; walking and panning shift the framing and crop people at transitions. Motion assessment is based on chronological frames rather than real-time playback.

videos.reason: The activity remains recognizable, but small subjects, subdued exposure and limited detail make this a visually weak wide shot.
videos.sequence: A man stands beside a red-helmeted woman as she looks down and handles lines near her harness; he walks behind her toward the turquoise kite while she continues looking at the gear.
videos.limitations: 394-by-848 resolution and distant framing obscure faces and small equipment details; the scene is rather dark, empty sand and sky occupy much of the frame, and handheld framing shifts slightly. No severe motion blur or major framing jump is apparent in the reviewed samples. Dense chronological frame review covered 26 samples from 0.000 to 6.254 seconds, including the first and last decoded frames, plus an individual full-size frame; real-time playback and audio were not assessed.

videos.reason: Clear full-body gestures, bright color and mostly consistent framing make the exchange easy to follow despite limited fine detail.
videos.sequence: A man moves his hands and changes foot position beside a helmeted person and a board on the sand; the helmeted person watches and briefly raises a hand toward their covered face.
videos.limitations: Low 394-by-848 resolution, some compressed texture and dark clothing detail, busy palm trunks behind the subjects and a camera shadow entering the lower edge. Dense chronological frame review, not real-time playback; audio not assessed.

videos.reason: The orange kite and moving offshore kites provide clear color and context, but the small shadowed person and broad empty sand reduce impact.
videos.sequence: A man bends and handles lines beside an orange kite, then walks along its front toward the right while a kitesurfer crosses the water behind him; the camera pans right to follow.
videos.limitations: Low 394-by-848 resolution, soft distant detail, shaded face, substantial empty foreground and slight horizon tilt during the handheld pan. Dense chronological frame review, not real-time playback; audio not assessed.

videos.reason: The vivid red kite and visible lifting action provide a clear subject, but its canopy hides people and the narrow low-resolution framing clips its edges.
videos.sequence: Three people stand behind a red-and-black kite; the person on the right lifts it into an arch, and the helmeted person in the middle crouches underneath and moves left as the kite remains raised.
videos.limitations: 394-by-848 resolution softens faces and distant detail; kite tips are intermittently clipped, the canopy obscures bodies, and deep foreground shade occupies a large area. Small handheld shifts are visible, with no major framing jump apparent in the samples. Dense chronological frame review covered 27 samples from 0.000 to 6.464 seconds, including the first and last decoded frames, plus an individual full-size frame; real-time playback and audio were not assessed.
